parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kettle is a detachable cover made of stainless steel, typically square or circular in shape, fitting snugly on the top opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping while boiling water and can be removed to fill or clean the kettle.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant Bakelite, attached to the kettle body for safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and pour the kettle without direct contact with the hot metal surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel with a spout and an opening for the lid.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water and transfers heat efficiently during boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main structural component of the kettle.
